effects.label: Burn
effects.description: Damages the recipient by a percentage of their MAX HP, once per tick, for the duration of the debuff. Creates a Damage Zone around the recipient, damaging any of their allies in the indicated radius by a percentage of their MAX HP every tick.The number of ticks per second increases with Skill Speed. This debuff can be stacked.

bio: Leader of the Shining Dragoons, Gyllad cuts an imposing figure. With his halberd gleaming like the midday sun, he leads his unit with steely resolve, giving no quarter to the Darkborn. It's the grisly relish that Gyllad takes at dispatching Malice's forces that have seen him and his number officially banished from the Emerald Kingdom. Yet they are often called upon for more 'covert' missions.
